monogr.title: Prompt You are an AI assistant trained to analyze reasoning steps in a response
Examine each reasoning step to determine if it's part of a reflection process
Identify the earliest step where the final answer (as later shown in boxed{}) is first derived, regardless of whether it is formally written or boxed at that moment
A reflection process is a sequence of one or more reasoning steps that recheck or doubt a previously made conclusion

biblStruct.note: such as double-checking calculations, using alternative methods

monogr.title: These signals usually mean the start of a new reflection process

biblStruct.note: Alternatively Just to double check But hold on Typical signals include (but are not limited to): 'Wait

monogr.title: even without such phrases, if the content of a step reflects a verification or reevaluation

biblStruct.note: it should be marked as a part of a reflection process

monogr.title: Reflection Step: List all reflection processes as groups of steps. -If Step3 and Step4 form a reflection, write as (Step3, Step4) -If Step5, Step6, Step7 form a new reflection process together

biblStruct.note: list as a separate group: [(Step3, Step4 Step7)] -Avoid putting a lot of steps into one single reflection process

monogr.title: First Answer Step: Write the earliest step where the final answer is first derived

analytic.title: First Correct Step: Step2 Explanations for Reflection Step: -There is 'wait', a reflection keyword, in Step3, so Step3 is the start of a reflection process. -There is 'But hold on' in step4, so step4 means the start of a new reflection process. -Then, there is 'wait' in step5, so step5 means the start of a new reflection process. -There is 'therefore' in step6, so (step5,step6) is in the same refleciton process. -There is 'alternatively' in step7

monogr.title: Step8: So, the answer is 5 Step9: **Final Answer**: the answer is boxed5. Output: Reflection Step

biblStruct.note: Example]: Question: 2 + 3 = ? Response: Step1: I start with 2 + 3. Step2: That gives me 5 Step3: Wait, is that right? Let me make sure Step4: But hold on, let me double-check. Maybe I should. Step5: Wait, no, I think. Step7, Step8) Step6: Therefore, the result is 5 Step7: Alternatively, if I use so step7 is the start of a new reflection process. -There is 'so' in step8, so (step7,step8) is in the same reflection process
